scope: Public input-interface contracts only. Historical filenames, artifact hashes, byte sizes, array dimensions and archive inventories are intentionally excluded. No omitted research data is bundled.

external_file_inputs.requirement: Caller supplies a real file compatible with the chosen study; no fallback or automatic selection.
Caller supplies the matching capture settings; no default private recovery location.
Caller supplies the explicit supported source dependency.

numerical_inputs.contract: The chosen source script declares the required array names, shape relationships, dtypes and units. Use a matching externally supplied state; source preservation does not provide or qualify that state.
Study-specific configuration or state; keys and validation are defined by the consuming source.
Study-specific numerical columns and units; see the consuming source.

validation_scope: The argument helper checks explicit path presence and file existence. It does not certify numerical compatibility or replay completeness.
